steps.en: Offender signs in to the portal with Singpass or Corppass
steps.id: Offender masuk ke portal dengan Singpass atau Corppass
steps.why_en: Login exists only on the Payment page, not for a Clearance Slip service
steps.why_id: Login hanya ada di halaman Payment, bukan untuk layanan Clearance Slip

steps.en: Offender picks the Clearance Slip service in the portal
steps.id: Offender memilih layanan Clearance Slip di portal
steps.why_en: The portal has only payment and furnish pages; there is no Clearance Slip service to choose.
steps.why_id: Portal hanya punya halaman pembayaran dan furnish; layanan Clearance Slip tidak ada untuk dipilih.

steps.en: The system recognises the offender's ID from the login session
steps.id: Sistem mengenali ID offender dari sesi login

steps.en: The system gets every notice under the offender's ID, unpaid and paid
steps.id: Sistem mengambil semua notice atas ID offender, belum dibayar dan sudah dibayar

steps.en: The system works out the offender still has unpaid warrants of arrest
steps.id: Sistem menentukan offender masih punya warrant of arrest yang belum dibayar
steps.why_en: The check compares a processing stage that is never sent to the page, so it never finds a warrant.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan membandingkan stage proses yang tidak pernah dikirim ke halaman, jadi warrant tidak pernah ketemu.

steps.en: The page tells the offender unpaid warrants of arrest must be paid
steps.id: Halaman memberi tahu offender bahwa warrant of arrest harus dibayar
steps.why_en: A warrant notice exists only on the payment screens and is never reached; it does not say payment comes before the clearance slip.
steps.why_id: Teks warrant hanya ada di layar pembayaran dan tidak pernah tercapai; isinya tidak menyebut bayar dulu sebelum clearance slip.

steps.en: The page guides the offender to pick unpaid notices and pay
steps.id: Halaman mengarahkan offender memilih notice yang belum dibayar lalu membayar
steps.why_en: Only the generic Payment page exists, not a Clearance Slip prompt
steps.why_id: Yang ada hanya halaman Payment umum, bukan prompt Clearance Slip

steps.en: The page says payment comes first before getting a copy of the clearance slip
steps.id: Halaman menyatakan bayar dulu sebelum bisa mendapat salinan clearance slip
steps.why_en: Nothing in the code links warrant payment to the clearance slip, so the message the story wants is not shown.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang menghubungkan pembayaran warrant dengan clearance slip, jadi pesan yang diminta story tidak muncul.
